# AgentRouter

> ⚠️ **重要说明**：npm 上的 [`opencode-agentrouter-auth`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-agentrouter-auth) **不是本仓库的正规发布**，也不是本插件；请勿用它安装本插件。本仓库的 npm 包名是 `opencode-agentrouter-auth1`。

Magpie 的 AgentRouter 供应商插件：五种独立登录方式、原生多账号与智能路由、可选每日签到，以及跨协议的请求保护。请求保护由供应商的 `auth.loader.fetch` 执行，不启动独立代理，不改 Codex 配置或本地会话，不给其他供应商套全局拦截器。

运行时使用 JavaScript、标准 Web API 和 Node 兼容的只读文件 API（自带图标及模型注册表），跑在 Magpie 的 Bun 插件宿主上，不依赖外部 shell 命令，不分 Windows、macOS、Linux。设计与验收标准见 [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md)，来源与许可见 [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md)。

## 安装

```sh
magpie plugin add opencode-agentrouter-auth1        # npm
magpie plugin add github:roiding/opencode-agentrouter-auth   # git
magpie plugin add /path/to/opencode-agentrouter-auth # 本地文件夹
magpie plugin login agentrouter
```

需要 Magpie 0.1.1813 及以上：账号密码与系统访问令牌登录依赖宿主的 `keyless` 支持，旧版会退回多余的 API key 提问。

本插件与社区 AgentRouter 插件使用相同的供应商 ID `agentrouter`。两者同时安装时，用 `magpie plugin use` 选择由哪个插件服务该供应商，不把两份认证实现串联。已有 API key、站点会话、用户 ID、显式端点及请求头会通过兼容层读取；不会删除账号、重置令牌或擅自改变旧的独立请求/站点地址。**旧账号即使保存了密码，也不会因此默认开启自动签到**；需要通过账号密码方式明确选择开启。其他供应商的配置不改。

## 登录方式

| 入口 | 需要提供什么 | 自动签到 | 余额 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 账号密码 | AgentRouter 站点用户名或邮箱、密码 | 可选，默认关闭（详见下方开启说明） | 有效站点会话允许时读取 |
| GitHub | 浏览器完成正常授权，再交接回调或本站会话 | 不自动执行每日 OAuth | 有效站点会话允许时读取 |
| LinuxDO | 浏览器完成正常授权，再交接本站会话 | 不自动执行每日 OAuth | 有效站点会话允许时读取 |
| 系统 Access Token | AgentRouter 系统令牌和用户 ID | 不允许 | 站点权限及防护允许时读取 |
| 模型 API key | 模型调用密钥 | 不允许 | 不查询账号余额 |

所有入口都提供端点选择和基础自定义头能力。账号名称从真实身份取得，显示别名通过添加后的 Magpie 原生“改名”设置；仅模型 API key 入口可选填写真实账号邮箱，因为模型 key 无法读取站点身份。账号级额外请求头、已有调用密钥 ID 放在可选高级设置中，不要求所有用户依次填密码、Cookie、访问令牌和各种备用凭据。

账号密码、OAuth 和系统令牌入口会读取账号已有的调用密钥：只有一个有效密钥时使用它；存在多个时要求明确选择数字 ID，不擅自选第一条。没有有效密钥会明确失败，要求用户在站点管理好密钥后再连接。不会调用重置系统访问令牌的 `/api/user/token`，也不会自动创建、旋转或删除调用密钥。

模型 API key 和系统 Access Token 是两类不同凭据，不能混用。API key 入口只提供模型发现和请求保护。

## GitHub / LinuxDO 回调与端点

每个账号选择 `agentrouter.org` 或 `ps.air-outer.com`。新账号的默认 API 与站点操作使用所选端点；OAuth 应用注册的回调仍是 `agentrouter.org`，之后的 AgentRouter 侧登录兑换可以在所选端点进行。

GitHub 默认沿用未消费授权码的交接方式：浏览器返回 `agentrouter.org/oauth/github/magpie` 后，将完整地址粘回 Magpie。该子路径可能显示未找到页面，这是为了不让站点普通回调页先兑换授权码。插件校验可信域名、路径和本次 state，再携带该流程自己的站点 Cookie 向所选端点兑换；授权码不能重放。

**LinuxDO 不假设可以沿用 GitHub 的回调子路径。** 默认走网站自己的完整登录流程，再由用户明确交接 AgentRouter 会话：

1. 在打开的站点登录页选择 LinuxDO，完成正常浏览器登录；必要时将返回地址中的 `agentrouter.org` 换成所选端点域名。
2. 登录后打开浏览器开发者工具的 Network，刷新账号页面，找到本站的 `GET /api/user/self`，选择 Copy as cURL（bash 格式）。
3. 将复制内容粘到 Magpie 的登录交接框。也可使用包含 `cookie` 和 `userId` 的 JSON 导出。

该内容是敏感凭据，只在本机 Magpie 中使用，不要粘贴到聊天、Issue 或日志。**插件只解析文本，不执行 cURL 或任何命令**，只接受已知 AgentRouter 域名的本站请求。随后只读校验用户 ID，再读取已有调用密钥。导入的浏览器客户端头仅用于本站接口，不覆盖模型请求的客户端标识。

GitHub 也可选择这种完整网页登录后的交接方式。LinuxDO 的未消费回调 URL 方式保留为高级选项，但不能拿已被站点网页兑换的授权码再试。

不保存 GitHub/LinuxDO 的网站登录 Cookie，不管理它们的多账号浏览器资料，不每天自动重新授权。OAuth 登录是否同时获得当日奖励，以站点实际响应为准，不能仅凭已有会话或余额刷新宣称签到成功。

## 签到、余额和多账号

> **【重点提示】开启每日自动签到步骤**
>
> 1. **添加账号时授权**：仅「账号密码」入口支持自动签到（GitHub、LinuxDO、系统访问令牌和模型 API key 均不自动执行签到）。在添加账密账号时，提示 `开启每日自动签到？` 请选择 `是 - 保存密码用于每日签到`。
> 2. **在 Magpie 设置中开启宿主权限**：完成账号添加后，**必须前往 Magpie 宿主设置开启调度开关**。路径为：打开 Magpie 的 **设置（Settings）› 额度（Allowances）**，在页面下方的每日签到列表中找到 **AgentRouter** 并将其滑块置为 **On**。
>    - Magpie 宿主默认对第三方插件不开启后台自动签到，必须在此处开启后，宿主后台例程才会将其纳入每日定时签到调度（通常在上午轮询执行）。
>    - 若配置了多个账密账号，在 AgentRouter 签到行下还可单独控制每个具体账号的签到开关。
>    - 打开开关后宿主会在下一个定时周期调度执行，非即时触发；也可在卡片上直接点击立即执行。

- 自动签到只由 Magpie 的 `auth.checkin` 调度。供应商启用签到后，插件仍要求该账号明确选择签到、并具备站点账密和用户 ID。
- 开启签到才把站点密码保存到 Magpie 本地认证存储；关闭时密码只用于当次登录。这里不是承诺使用系统钥匙串或加密存储，仍需保护本机认证文件。
- 签到是站点登录操作，响应 `checked_in: true` 才记为新领取；当日已处理则不再次登录。并发重复调用会合并。
- 返回的站点用户 ID 必须匹配目标账号；错误密码、验证码或账号变更不能覆盖另一个账号的会话，也不误判独立模型 key 失效。
- `auth.usage` 严格只读，不因查余额失败而登录签到。余额缺失或受 WAF 拦截时显示未知；累计消耗不是余额，未知不是零。
- 站点同时返回余额与累计消耗时，用两者生成可切换的“已用/剩余”金额窗口；只有余额时保留 Magpie 的钱包余额字段参加原生路由。百分比来自站点实际数据，不伪造重置窗口。签到奖励增加余额，不等于额度每天自动重置。

可重复添加多个账号。每个账号的端点、凭据、模型和签到状态独立，由 Magpie 决定账号选择、冷却、并发及故障切换；插件内部没有隐藏的账号池。按意图换模型也使用 Magpie 的原生路由组，过滤器自己不换模型。

### 真实账号名、显示别名与旧记录

真实账号名与显示别名是两回事。新登录的 `accountId` 优先采用站点真实邮箱，缺失时采用站点用户名，仍缺失才使用站点 UID。账密和 OAuth 的登录响应可能不含邮箱，因此完成登录时会额外读取并校验 `/api/user/self`；系统令牌和会话导入已读取该接口，不重复查询。身份不匹配或资料验证失败时不保存账号，也不凭备注猜测邮箱。

原实现把“账号备注”放在 `email` 提问中，再优先写入 `accountId`，导致 `maodou38` 这样的显示别名被当作原账号名。这是插件的字段混用问题，不应解释成正常的备注行为。现在不再将备注当作账号身份；旧流程中已填写的备注仅作为 `label` 保留，不参与账号名或 UID 的生成。

当前已验证的 Magpie 0.1.1976 插件 SDK 没有登录时写入原生显示别名的接口，因此撤掉误导性的“账号备注”输入，而不是返回一个宿主不识别的 `alias` 字段或直接改写宿主配置。添加完成后使用 Magpie 原生“改名”：例如账号名 `alice@example.test`，显示别名 `roiding`。部分界面仍会并列显示别名与真实账号名；两个不同邮箱使用相同显示别名，不会因此变成两个同名原账号。若真实账号名本身重复或身份未知，宿主仍可能显示槽位标记，不能删除 UID 来掩盖。

旧记录不会在加载、余额刷新或签到时静默改写 `accountId`：宿主别名和部分路由设置按原账号名关联，直接替换会丢失关联。旧记录缺少邮箱时也不能把备注当作邮箱。当前宿主对“相同 UID、不同账号名”的重新添加不保证去重，**不要把再次添加或删除旧账号当成无损迁移**；迁移必须同时保留存储槽位、别名及按名称关联的设置，需要宿主侧配合。这里修复新登录的命名来源，不宣称已自动迁移既有账号。

余额接口不返回 `usage.user`，不拿站点用户名覆盖宿主账号名；读取余额不修改名称、别名、UID 或凭据。

## 模型与请求头

**没有默认模型。** 模型目录按账号发现，公共元数据只补充已发现模型的协议、能力、推理档位和上限，不凭公共定价表或注册表扩大账号可用列表。用户显式声明的模型和 API 地址作为人工覆盖保留，最终权限仍由上游校验。发现失败时保留可信缓存/显式配置，不退回写死的模型名单。

模型元数据逐字段按以下优先级解析：用户覆盖、账号 `/models` 声明、本站 `/api/pricing`、对应服务商注册表、原厂精确型号、可信同族信息，最后才使用宿主已有字段。读取 `limit.context/input/output`、`reasoning_options`、推理/工具/输入输出模态等能力；将原厂声明的 effort 转成 `capabilities.reasoning` 和 `variants`，不统一塞入 `low/medium/high/xhigh`。用户可通过 `variants.<档位>.disabled` 隐藏档位；显式 `reasoning: false` 禁用推理档位。仅有 toggle 或 budget 控制时不编造 effort 档位。注册表只补充总上下文 `context` 和输出上限 `output`，不提供 `input`：Magpie 把插件模型的 `input` 直接当作告知 agent（并导出给 Codex）的窗口，继承厂商规格会把 1M 总窗口压成 922k 输入上限，模型选择器的 1M 徽标也会因此消失；`input` 只认用户覆盖、账号声明、本站 pricing 或宿主已有配置。

优先只读宿主的原始 `models.json` 缓存，避免宿主规范化时丢失 `reasoning_options`；缓存不可用时匿名读取 `https://models.dev/api.json`，不发送账号凭据。内存缓存每五分钟重新检查，可用插件选项 `modelsRegistryPath` 指定只读注册表路径。带日期的别名仅在完整基型号的多个已知版本一致时回退；其他同族回退必须有明确 family 声明，并且只补充原厂多个同族成员一致的字段。不同型号对 `none` 等档位存在分歧时不取并集。

`context` 是总上下文，`input` 是独立输入上限，`output` 是输出上限，不互相冒充，也不通过相加猜测总窗口。缺失值保持未知；低优先级的上限不能覆盖更高优先级声明，也不能留下明显矛盾的窗口。Magpie 可能为 Codex 选择输入上限，并在 compact 模式下另设工作窗口；Codex 的工作窗口不等同于模型总上下文。**不要手改会重新生成的 Codex 模型目录**，更新插件并正常刷新模型，由宿主重新导出。

模型 API 可以是 Responses、Chat Completions、Anthropic Messages 或 Gemini。用户显式 SDK/模型配置优先；不使用一个无条件的 loader `baseURL` 覆盖所有模型的独立地址。AgentRouter 元数据只写 `openai` 时无法区分 Chat 与 Responses，默认按该站点现有 Responses 接入，仍允许用户明确覆盖 SDK。

自定义头不是某种登录的附加特权。模型请求原样透传 Magpie 已合并的本次请求/当前模型头；账号自定义头可以覆盖它们，不混合其他模型的头。兼容客户端标识（默认开启，可关闭）只在 Responses 协议上把网关替换掉的客户端身份恢复为 codex 客户端标识，账号自定义头仍然优先。登录、签到和账户信息等站点请求统一使用 Chrome 浏览器请求头（含 `Origin`/`Referer`），账号自定义头和会话导入的浏览器头优先于默认值。认证头使用当前账号的模型密钥，并按出站协议选择 Bearer、`x-api-key` 或 `x-goog-api-key`。站点 Cookie、系统令牌及用户 ID 不发送到模型接口。

账号级自定义头不能直接覆盖认证、Cookie、Host、连接与长度等受管理字段；此类凭据应由对应登录方式维护。

## 多协议请求保护

保护四类对话 API 的流式与非流式请求：

1. 首次保留请求体原始字节；普通重试也保留，不预先删历史、不替换 `model`。这里指 `fetch` 收到的上游协议请求；Magpie 可能已转换客户端协议。
2. 仅 Responses 的明确资源不匹配、会话绑定失效（`session binding invalidated` / code 30013）或 `invalid_encrypted_content` 才执行已验证的历史清理。资源不匹配同时识别原始 `Azure OpenAI resource` 和 AgentRouter 脱敏后的 `*** OpenAI resource`，仍要求完整的两句资源错误说明；兼容上游增加的 `OpenAI Responses bad request:` 前缀。会话绑定失效兼容 HTTP 400/409、JSON/纯文本/SSE 错误体；两者也会识别 SDK 包装成 `stream disconnected before completion: ...` 的异常消息。会话绑定清理后同时轮换请求中的会话标识并只重试一次。非流式 HTTP 200 中明确的错误对象也在交付前检查。
3. 清理保留消息正文、图片、phase、工具参数/结果及 `call_id` 配对；需要无法恢复的服务端引用、压缩或 item reference 时明确失败，不静默丢上下文。
4. Chat、Anthropic、Gemini 不套用 Responses 字段删除。thinking、signature、thoughtSignature 不会因为泛化错误而被删掉；未经验证的签名修复不猜着做。
5. 限流、传输与已识别的可用性错误有限重试；502/504 等状态中的明确 `upstream_idle_timeout`、`stream_disconnected` 错误也进入传输重试，不再只识别 HTTP 200 内的同类错误。认证失败、余额不足和普通参数错误不触发清理。

单次选定供应商调用最多额外重试 20 次，资源/限流/传输/可用性分别最多 5/20/10/10 次；会话绑定失效单独最多恢复一次，不会在同一个失败绑定上循环。遵守服务端等待提示、总期限、空闲期限和客户端取消。Magpie 跨账号故障切换是独立外层，不应把这里的 20 次宣传为整条调用链的总数。

SSE 在确认有效终止前不交付内容或客户端工具调用。Responses 识别 completed/incomplete；Chat 检查 choices 和 DONE；Anthropic 检查 message_stop；Gemini 检查候选项结束或合法阻断，并等待正常流结束、保留用量尾帧。失败尝试整体丢弃，同一网络块中终止标记之后的多余内容不泄露。合法拒绝、长度终止不当成断流重放。

缓冲不再等于下游完全静默。流式请求等待超过默认 10 秒后，提前返回 SSE，并定期发送不含 response/item ID、正文或工具调用的非内容事件。Responses 使用 Codex 能解析但不当作输出的 `response.in_progress`；其他协议使用对应空进度帧。只发送 `: keepalive` 注释不足以重置 Codex 的 SSE **事件**空闲时钟。保活覆盖上游等待和重试退避，但不会重置独立的上游空闲计时或总期限；日志中的 `sse-keepalive-started` 表示已启用本次下游保活。

快速响应保留原 HTTP 状态和响应头。保活开始后 HTTP 头已提交，后续失败通过 SSE 错误事件交付，携带原始错误码、HTTP 状态及重试/认证提示，不拼接裸 JSON，也不伪造完成。成功 SSE 保留上游 ID 和事件字节；上游退回完整 JSON 时，只转换协议已终止的结果，不把处理中或失败状态伪造成完成。依赖完整原始 HTTP 响应头的调用方可设置 `keepaliveMs: 0` 关闭提前交付。Magpie 自身还可能暂存非内容事件；当前实测版本最多暂存约四分钟，因此网关版本、代理缓冲或更短的客户端超时仍需独立检查，不能承诺消除所有断流。

未知路径及上传、删除、批任务、站点管理等操作不盲目重放。压缩/二进制请求体暂按原格式透传，不冒充能够安全清理；正常 fetch 自动解压的上游 JSON/SSE 响应可以处理。插件不能扩展 Magpie 尚未提供的网关入口。

全量缓冲增加首字等待。默认单个请求/响应缓冲上限 64 MiB，并非整个宿主的内存上限；并发及拷贝会增加峰值。取消会中止读取和退避；超限明确失败，不改成先输出再重试。它不保证上游工具或推理只执行/计费一次。

## 开关与参数

供应商开关「安全重试加密历史错误」只控制请求保护，不影响认证及账号能力。默认开启。插件选项示例：

```json
{
  "quotaPerUnit": 500000,
  "filter": {
    "enabled": true,
    "deadlineMs": 1800000,
    "idleTimeoutMs": 120000,
    "keepaliveMs": 10000,
    "maxBufferBytes": 67108864,
    "maxRequestBytes": 67108864
  }
}
```

日志只记录结构化事件、类别、计数和耗时，不记录请求正文、密码、Cookie、令牌、授权码或 state。Magpie 当前宿主会丢弃日志的 `extra` 字段，因此这些安全诊断也写进 `message`，可以直接看到 `kind`、`errorCode`、清理计数和重试次数，而不只是事件名。

## 开发

```sh
npm test
bun test
```

普通测试只使用模拟数据和本地 HTTP 服务，不读取真实账号或调用收费模型。真实 Magpie 宿主/网关测试默认跳过，必须明确提供测试路径：

```sh
MAGPIE_TEST_HOST=/path/to/host.js MAGPIE_TEST_BUN=/path/to/bun npm run test:host
MAGPIE_TEST_BINARY=/path/to/magpie MAGPIE_TEST_BUN=/path/to/bun npm run test:gateway
MAGPIE_TEST_BINARY=/path/to/magpie MAGPIE_TEST_BUN=/path/to/bun MAGPIE_TEST_SSE_IDLE=1 npm run test:gateway
```

宿主脚本应来自隔离 HOME 中 Magpie 写出的缓存。这些测试创建临时配置、模拟账号和回环服务，并在结束后清理，不修改现有 Magpie 配置。

`MAGPIE_TEST_SSE_IDLE=1` 额外运行约四分钟的真实网关测试，模拟 Codex 的五分钟 SSE 事件空闲计时：注释不算活动，收到真实进度事件后才允许上游完成。这能发现只在过滤器单测中“保活成功”、经过网关却仍无事件的问题。

本包自包含，不捆绑上游源码。旧通用供应商入口 `generic.mjs` 继续保留，用于非 AgentRouter 场景，不会由默认入口自动注册。

# AgentRouter provider: implementation contract

This document is the design contract for the implementation. It is not a
claim that every listed gate has passed at any given commit.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Separate password, GitHub, LinuxDO, system access-token and API-key login methods. Ask only relevant questions. | Method/prompt tests and an isolated Magpie host login. |
| R2 | Unattended check-in is opt-in and requires AgentRouter site credentials. | Disabled, missing-credential, wrong-user, captcha, daily-deduplication and persistence tests. |
| R3 | Select agentrouter.org or ps.air-outer.com per account. Preserve explicit legacy addresses. | URL resolution and migration tests for both endpoints. |
| R4 | Use native Magpie account records, account pools and smart/intent routing. Do not build a hidden account pool in fetch. | Concurrent-account tests and isolated host account/failover tests. |
| R5 | Custom headers are a baseline feature for every login method. Preserve native request/model overrides. | Header precedence, credential-boundary and selected-model tests. |
| R6 | API-key-only accounts provide inference protection and model discovery, not site-account features. | Tests proving that usage/check-in make no account API requests. |
| R7 | Preserve interactive GitHub and LinuxDO login, including callback-to-selected-endpoint mapping. Do not retain third-party browser sessions or automate daily OAuth. | State/cookie/code/identity tests plus supervised real login for each identity provider (completed 2026-10-29). |
| R8 | Protect Responses, Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages and Gemini, streaming and non-streaming. | Protocol-specific HTTP/SSE fixtures, cancellation and real local HTTP tests. |
| R9 | First request body unchanged; clean only an exact recoverable history error; bounded retries; no failed SSE output delivered. | Byte-level preservation, negative classification, replay limits and withheld-tool tests. |
| R10 | No default model, no changes to other providers, no OS-specific runtime or background proxy. | Config/model tests, source inspection, Node and Bun runs. |

## Ownership and modules

- Magpie owns account selection, per-account proxies, concurrency, smart routing,
  cross-account failover, check-in scheduling, and persistent credential storage.
- `index.mjs` assembles hooks and wraps only this provider's model transport.
- Account normalization owns versioned credentials and conservative migration.
- The site client owns login, OAuth state/exchange, account reads and key lookup.
  It is not wrapped by inference retries.
- Provider hooks own the login UI, account capabilities, model metadata and headers.
- The filter owns one selected-provider attempt. Protocol adapters describe the
  request, error envelope, completion conditions and permitted history repair.

## Authentication and persistence

Login methods are independent native buttons. Password and access-token methods
use the host's keyless API-method support, so there is no extra implicit API-key
question. Secrets use password prompts. Advanced fields are conditional.

| Mode | Unattended check-in | Account reads | Persistent secrets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| API key | No | No | Inference key only |
| Access token | No | Read-only, if accepted by the site | Site token, user ID, selected inference key |
| Password, check-in off | No | Read-only site session | Site session and selected inference key; not the password |
| Password, check-in on | Yes | Read-only site session | Above plus explicitly authorized site username/password |
| GitHub / LinuxDO | No | Read-only site session | AgentRouter session and selected inference key only |

The account's site UID is authoritative. Reauthentication and check-in must not
replace it with another user's data. Account labels are display information,
not an identity or secret. Do not deduplicate different users by a shared label.

New account envelopes use the verified site's email as `accountId`, falling
back to its username and finally its UID, never the remark. Login/OAuth exchange
responses can omit email: read the authenticated profile and verify its UID
before key lookup and persistence. Session import and system-token login already
read this profile and must not read it twice. A profile failure is not permission
to guess identity. Keep the actual login's check-in result separate from this
read-only profile response.

The current host SDK exposes no login-time native-alias setter. Do not offer a
fake alias prompt, repurpose its `email` field for a remark, invent a no-op SDK
method, or rewrite native configuration files. Let users set display aliases
through Magpie's native rename operation after login. The pure model-key method
may accept an optional actual email but cannot verify it with site credentials.
Legacy in-flight remarks remain in `label`, not the canonical account name.

Keep both corrected and legacy `accountId` values stable during session updates
so native aliases and name-keyed routing are not orphaned. Migration of existing
records requires the host to preserve their slots and name-keyed settings; the
current host does not deduplicate equal UIDs with different names on re-add.
`auth.usage` leaves `user` unset and never migrates credentials. Distinct site
UIDs must stay distinct even if their actual email addresses match. Slot suffixes
for truly duplicate/unknown identities remain the host's concern; shared display
aliases alone must not manufacture a duplicate canonical account name.

Account modes that acquire a key use an OAuth-shaped Magpie storage envelope
with `expires: 0` and versioned plugin state in `refresh`, as the native ZCode
plugin does. This is a storage envelope, not a GitHub/LinuxDO refresh token.
It also avoids the host automatically persisting all password prompt inputs in
API-key metadata. The loader uses only the normalized inference key.

Read existing keys; never reset a system access token or create/rotate a model
key implicitly. Use an explicitly selected active key, or the sole active key.
If there is ambiguity or the key list is unavailable, explain what is missing;
never persist a successful but keyless inference account.

Legacy account reads may retain existing site credentials, but check-in defaults
off unless an explicit account opt-in is present. Merely finding an old password
is not consent to daily logins. Existing custom request/site URLs are not moved
silently. Pure legacy API keys remain pure API keys.

## OAuth and endpoint mapping

The registered OAuth callback origin is agentrouter.org. The selected endpoint
can perform the subsequent AgentRouter-side exchange. These are different
addresses; selecting the mirror does not rewrite the identity provider's
registered callback or send its cookies to AgentRouter.

Each flow owns its state, anonymous site cookies, provider, selected endpoint,
expiration and one-shot callback. Validate the entire callback URL and state.
Accept only the known callback origins/paths. Perform the exchange on the same
selected site that issued the state. Never replay a consumed code.

The existing GitHub implementation avoids the site's consuming SPA callback by
using a child path. Whether LinuxDO accepts an equivalent callback must be
verified, not assumed. LinuxDO therefore defaults to completing the site's own
browser login and explicitly handing its resulting AgentRouter session back to
the plugin. The user pastes the site's `/api/user/self` request copied as cURL,
or a JSON session export. Clipboard text is parsed, never executed. Only a
trusted AgentRouter origin, the session Cookie, user ID, and site-only client
headers are accepted; a read-only self request verifies the identity before
key lookup. This avoids relying on an already-consumed OAuth code. Both methods
are available for GitHub as well. Real-browser logins for GitHub and LinuxDO
were verified against the live endpoints on 2026-10-29.
No third-party relay, daily browser-session replay, CAPTCHA solver, or persistent
GitHub/LinuxDO session belongs in this plugin.

## Check-in, balances and routing

`usage` is read-only. It never falls back to login. Unknown balances are not
zero, and token allowances or cumulative spend are not account balances. When
the site reports both remaining quota and cumulative spend, expose their sum as
the window total so Magpie's Used/Left switch has a real share. When cumulative
spend is absent, use the wallet balance alone for routing. An API-only account
returns no fabricated quota window.

`checkin` requires account opt-in plus site username/password and runs only when
Magpie schedules it. Deduplicate concurrent and completed Beijing-day attempts
for the same site UID. Validate the UID returned by login before updating any
session. A site's password/session failure must not invalidate a working model
key. A newly successful login may update that account's site session and balance.
CAPTCHA is a user-action outcome, not a retry loop. A daily reward is not an
automatic quota reset; do not fabricate midnight reset windows for routing.

## Headers, models and request boundaries

Use native model/request headers as authoritative overrides. Account defaults
fill missing fields; do not merge headers from unrelated models. Apply the
selected account's inference credential using the outgoing protocol. Never
forward site cookies, site access tokens or passwords to inference endpoints.

Discover models per account. Preserve explicit user model declarations/settings
as manual overrides and trusted fallback lists; the upstream still enforces
their permissions. Public pricing/registry metadata can describe capabilities but cannot
by itself add models absent from the account's catalog. Do not invent a default
model, context limit, quota, or permission. An explicit model API address must
not be defeated by an unconditional loader baseURL.

Resolve model metadata per field: user declarations, authenticated discovery,
provider public metadata, corresponding registry, exact manufacturer model,
conservative family consensus, then host fallback. Keep total context, input
ceiling and output ceiling separate. The registry never supplies the input
ceiling: Magpie serves a plugin model's input as the window agents are told
and Codex is exported, so an inherited maker's spec would advertise a 922k
prompt cap in place of the 1M total context. Only user declarations, the
account's discovery, the site's pricing or host fallback set input. Preserve
explicit false capabilities and derive effort variants only from declarations,
never a universal model-name heuristic. Family inference requires multiple
agreeing manufacturer entries; do not union differing effort sets. The raw
registry cache is read-only and anonymous network fallback is bounded; neither
source creates account access. Do not edit regenerated Codex catalogs. Both
provider entry points use this resolver.

The native gateway can retain the first seat's URL while trying another account.
The loader therefore resolves the selected account's default endpoint at dispatch,
using a stripped internal model hint from `chat.headers` to retain explicit
per-model API overrides. A reused URL must not keep the previous account's domain.

The filter sees Magpie's already-converted upstream protocol. Its first body is
preserved at this boundary, not necessarily at the agent's original boundary.
Unknown paths, management operations and non-replayable request formats pass
through without speculative repair or replay.

## Transport invariants

1. Preserve the original body for the first request and every non-cleaning retry.
2. Only a protocol-specific, explicit history error can authorize a repair.
   Responses resource mismatch, encrypted history and session-binding invalidation
   may repair once; binding recovery also rotates the request's session identity.
   The same exact signatures are recognized when an SDK wraps them in a thrown
   stream-disconnection error.
   Authentication, quota, generic parameter and overload errors cannot do so.
3. Responses retains its safe portable-history transformation and rejects
   references/compaction it cannot reconstruct. Other protocols never receive
   Responses field deletions. Required thinking/tool signatures are not discarded.
4. One selected-provider invocation has the existing combined 20-retry limit and
   resource/rate/transport/availability budgets of 5/20/10/10; binding recovery
   is capped at one retry. Magpie failover is a
   separate outer operation; caller cancellation bounds it, not a fake global
   counter shared between accounts.
5. Honor server wait hints, idle and total deadlines, cancellation during every
   stage, and request/response memory bounds. Buffered overflows fail, not leak.
6. Hold SSE output until a protocol-valid terminal result. Discard failed attempt
   text and client tool calls. Legitimate refusals/length stops are terminal,
   not transport failures. Keep usage trailers where the protocol requires them.
   While buffering, allow bounded non-content keepalive events with no attempt
   IDs. Comments alone do not count as Codex SSE event activity. Keepalive does
   not reset upstream idle/deadline timers or relax cancellation/retry budgets.
7. Responses uses completed/incomplete events; Chat uses completed choices and
   DONE; Anthropic uses message_stop; Gemini uses completed candidates or a
   terminal prompt block plus a well-formed normal stream end.
8. Preserve authoritative status, error details and routing/auth hints. Remove
   stale content-length/content-encoding only when returning decoded/rebuilt data.
   Fast errors retain HTTP semantics. Once keepalive commits an SSE response,
   encode late errors in-band with original status and hints; never append bare
   JSON or claim successful completion. Full original response headers cannot
   be restored after commitment; callers requiring them can disable keepalive.
9. Log structural diagnostics only. No prompt, body, password, cookie, token,
   authorization URL, state or code belongs in logs.
10. Buffering is not upstream exactly-once execution. Retried hosted tools and
    inference may already have run or incurred cost. Document latency and cost.

## Release gates

- [x] Versioned account state, conditional login prompts and opt-in persistence.
- [x] Read-only usage, UID-checked check-in and no fabricated routing windows.
- [x] Endpoint/header/model isolation and explicit legacy configuration retention.
- [x] All four inference protocols, HTTP/SSE errors and buffer/cancellation limits.
- [x] Node and Bun automated tests, including actual local compressed HTTP streams.
- [x] Isolated Magpie host: login UX, multiple accounts, models and failover.
- [x] Supervised GitHub and LinuxDO login against the real selected endpoint (2026-10-29).
- [x] Documentation, provenance and checksum manifest match the implementation.

Real-account validation is deliberately separate from mock coverage. No paid
inference, real credential changes, proxy mutation or third-party browser-session
capture is performed by the automated test suite.

# Upstream Sources

This plugin draws on two MIT-licensed projects:

- AgentRouter provider: https://github.com/ZhaoJun233/agentrouter-magpie-plugin
  - Pinned commit: `1049163f2cd95b39b55b9ca23b1d91b139a80423` (2026-10-28).
  - Behavioral reference only. No code from it is bundled in this package; the
    account, login, check-in, catalog and wallet behavior was reimplemented
    against the Magpie plugin contract.
- Conditional history policy: https://github.com/yidu456/magpie-auto-codex-filter
  - Based on the policy at commit `cd68b072ddf3475203d42661d9cdca3a93212100`.
  - Copyright (c) 2026 alexcarterio and contributors; license in `LICENSE`.
  - `lib/responses-filter.mjs` adapts the policy to Web Fetch streams without Node-specific APIs or configuration rewriting. `lib/protocols.mjs` adds protocol-specific framing and error handling without applying Responses history deletion to other protocols.

`index.mjs` now composes the new `lib/provider.mjs` hooks with the shared filter.
`lib/accounts.mjs`, `lib/site-client.mjs`, `lib/headers.mjs` and `lib/catalog.mjs`
implement the explicit account modes, conservative migration, separate site
operations and per-model configuration. There are no mandatory GitHub system
tokens, login-based balance fallbacks or hard-coded model names in this runtime.
Site-password/session errors do not invalidate the independent inference key.

The multi-account, keyless-login and wallet-balance integration is based on the
Magpie plugin contract and verified against the installed 0.1.1976 host
(`300b7eee083d5e24fa7a55fe18974586308844d5`). Native
ZCode is a behavioral/API reference, not code copied into this package. Real
GitHub/LinuxDO browser handoffs remain a separately documented release gate.

Model metadata and SSE liveness references (reviewed 2026-10-29):

- The installed Magpie host's `fromModelsDev` keeps context/input/output and
  capabilities but drops `reasoning_options` when initializing `variants`.
  Its native export consumes `capabilities.reasoning` and variant keys.
- The maintained `@magpie-community/opencode-zen-free-auth` plugin maps
  models.dev effort declarations to `{ reasoningEffort: effort }` variants.
  This is an API/behavior reference; no fixed model profiles are copied here.
- Raw public registry: https://models.dev/api.json . Its provider-specific and
  manufacturer records are capability evidence, never account availability.
- Official Codex source: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/codex-api/src/sse/responses.rs .
  `process_sse` waits on parsed SSE events, so comments do not prevent
  `idle timeout waiting for SSE`. `response.in_progress` is non-content activity.
- Magpie's native gateway `fallback.go` holds lead events for up to four minutes
  and sends comment keepalives while waiting. The optional isolated gateway
  test therefore measures event liveness through the actual installed gateway,
  not only activity in the plugin or receipt of HTTP headers.

`lib/model-metadata.mjs` and `lib/model-registry.mjs` implement the shared
metadata resolver and read-only registry acquisition. `lib/sse-delivery.mjs`
separates non-content downstream liveness from buffered retry decisions; it
does not rewrite a winning upstream stream's response IDs or sequence numbers.

Account-name interoperability (reviewed 2026-10-29 against the same pinned
Magpie 0.1.1976 source):

- The plugin's original `saveAccount` preferred the user remark over the site's
  email, and its prompt called that remark `email`. That was a plugin identity
  bug, not a valid native alias contract. New logins use a UID-verified profile's
  email/username, retain legacy remarks only as labels, and no longer offer the
  misleading alias prompt.
- `internal/plugin/host.js`: `makeClient` exposes auth writes, configuration
  reads, logs and toasts; `input.magpie` exposes options, not a native alias
  setter. Unknown SDK client calls are no-op stubs. `save` and
  `internal/plugin/providers.go`'s `Saved` return provider/account only.
  `internal/provider/pluginsignin.go` and `internal/gui/plugins.go` do not turn
  a login input into a native display alias. The separate
  `/api/provider/accountname` GUI endpoint in `internal/gui/providers.go` is
  not an exposed plugin SDK method; this package does not guess its address,
  launch a native CLI from login, or patch host storage to invoke it.
- `internal/provider/plugin_accounts.go`: `pluginLabels` disambiguates equal
  `accountId` names, case-insensitively, by appending the `#slot` suffix of a
  sibling account's storage key. Display aliases do not change this decision.
- `internal/provider/account_names.go`: `SetAccountName` stores aliases in
  `providers.json`, not in plugin credentials. The GUI's
  `internal/gui/tests/account-alias.test.cjs` explicitly expects the original
  account name beside its alias; `internal/cli/accounts_alias_cli_test.go`
  expects `alias (original)` in quota titles. These are host display policies,
  not plugin-generated parentheses or proof that a rename was lost. They do
  not excuse passing an alias as the original account name.
- `internal/plugin/host.js`: `settle` compares names before UIDs. An existing
  account cannot be migrated safely just by returning its email instead of its
  old remark, even with the same UID. Refreshes therefore preserve existing
  envelope names, and existing-name migration is explicitly not claimed.
- `internal/provider/plugin_usage.go`: a nonempty `usage.user` replaces the
  canonical login name in the raw quota result. Current quota cards restore
  it in `perLogin` (`subscription_usage.go`); this is not the root cause of
  their parentheses. The plugin now omits the optional `user` field so the
  site username never becomes a third name for the host to reconcile.
- Native CLI caveat: `accounts --json` in this host looks up aliases with the
  login agent (`plugin:agentrouter`), while `SetAccountName` stores them by
  `PluginID` (`agentrouter`, or `agentrouter-plugin` on a provider-ID collision).
  The isolated gateway test checks shared aliases, a later rename, saved aliases
  and the quota export against distinct real-email account names. It verifies
  byte-for-byte that renaming leaves plugin credentials unchanged. No installed
  host or real account files are patched to work around native presentation.

Allowance-window behavior (reviewed 2026-10-30 against installed Magpie
0.1.2173):

- A plugin usage window carrying `balance` is treated as a wallet-only figure,
  so the host's global Used/Left switch leaves it unchanged. AgentRouter reports
  `quota` (remaining) and `used_quota` (cumulative spend), so the plugin maps
  their real share to `used`, spend to `amount`, and their sum to `limit`.
  Balance-only data remains the fallback when cumulative spend is unavailable.

This package is self-contained: all runtime sources, tests and documentation
live at the repository root. Update this record whenever an external reference
informs a behavioral decision, and keep attribution for adapted MIT code.
